gate_results.rationale: Authoritative review facts show technology reaches end-of-life in 4 months ('technology_eol_months': 4), which is under the 12-month threshold, triggering IT-EOL-001. Under the active standing mandate from the risk owner covering all risk-acceptable findings, conditional approval was executed requiring a convergence plan, yielding GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS.

Authoritative review facts show reversibility_status is 'draft' ("reversibility_status": "draft"), which triggers finding ARCH-REV-001. All other architecture criteria are satisfied (ip_overlap is false, api_gateway_present is true, data_owner_present is true, measured_latency_ms (30) <= latency_target_ms (50), and multi_az is true). Under the active standing mandate from risk owner Amira Petrescu-12010-RO covering all risk-acceptable findings, conditional approval was executed with the condition COMPLETE_EXIT_ARCHITECTURE, resulting in disposition GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS.

Authoritative review facts identify three security findings: (1) SEC-WAF-002 due to WAF operating in detection-only mode ("waf_mode": "Detection"), requiring ENABLE_WAF_PREVENTION; (2) SEC-NET-001 because the workload handles Confidential data but lacks private endpoints ("private_endpoints": false), requiring ENABLE_PRIVATE_ENDPOINTS; and (3) SEC-VULN-001 due to an open critical vulnerability ("critical_vulns_open": 1), requiring REMEDIATE_CRITICAL_VULNERABILITIES. Under the decision policy priority, the critical non-risk-acceptable findings result in a final disposition of NO_GO, which requires authorization.

Authoritative review facts identify three findings: (1) TR-RESTORE-001 due to no successful restore test being available ("restore_tested": false), requiring RUN_RESTORE_TEST; (2) TR-CODE-001 due to 2 open critical static-analysis findings ("critical_static_findings": 2), requiring REMEDIATE_BUILD_FINDINGS; and (3) TR-OPS-001 due to an incomplete operational package with runbook status missing ("runbook_status": "missing"), requiring COMPLETE_OPERATIONAL_HANDOVER. Based on the decision policy priority, the presence of non-acceptable REWORK findings results in an overall disposition of REWORK, which does not require authorization.

Authoritative review facts show that requested funding of €3,000,000 exceeds the approved envelope of €2,550,000 ("budget_approved_eur": 2550000), triggering GEN-BUDGET-001. Furthermore, upstream review records show 1 upstream gate (Security) returned NO_GO ("disposition": "NO_GO"), triggering GEN-UPSTREAM-NOGO. Under the decision policy priority, the critical non-risk-acceptable upstream finding dictates an overall disposition of NO_GO, which requires authorization.
